definitions.accuracy_population_sd_pp: Population SD of observed epoch accuracies, ddof0; includes trends
definitions.mean_absolute_change_pp: Mean absolute difference between consecutive epoch accuracies; lower means smaller jumps
definitions.change_population_sd_pp: Population SD of signed consecutive differences, ddof0

protocol: Same contiguous epoch window for all six readers within each comparison. Real2-19 and6-19; synthetic2-17 and6-17. No interpolation, smoothing, A/B averaging, checkpoint selection or training changes.
limitation: Descriptive variation along one training trajectory per dataset, not independent-run variance or statistical proof of curriculum effects. Real results are repeatedly inspected historical diagnostics.
